verdict.rationale: Render's MCP server supports OAuth-based authentication for Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor, so agents get a delegated credential rather than a pasted static key. Separately, managed OIDC issues short-lived, auto-rotated identity tokens so services can call Anthropic and OpenAI without long-lived keys. Neither item shows that a user can restrict an agent's Render API access to specific scopes, resources, or permissions. Missing for 10: documented scoped or least-privilege Render API tokens, per-resource or read-only permission controls for agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
